0.0: It's been a long time! You've adjusted well to the new world, I'm very proud of you. So, I was wondering if I could ask you a favor...

yes.0: #m310000000# does not have enough resources, which is why everything is recycled. I will be able to help you get settled if you can bring me #b60#k #b#t4000602#s and #b60#k #t4000603#s#k  to recycle.

no.0: Come back to me if you change your mind.

1.0: Thank you for your hard work. I can't believe you returned so quickly! It seems like you have completely settled here.

yes.0: To repay you for helping the town, I will give you a Support Fund. I hope it helps you during your stay.
